about.what: Live Pokéfind survival recipes, laid out per crafting station for rendering on a web page.

unlocks.how: A recipe with an 'unlock' key is only craftable once the player holds that key (granted by quest scripts) or carries a Recipe Scroll for it. 'unlock': null means available from the start. What earns each key is defined in quest scripts, not here.

menu.name: Weapons and Tools
menu.description: Diamond tools and weapons will only get yourself so far in this world! Get yourself some new and improved tools and weapons with these recipes.

menu.name: Armor
menu.description: Diamond armor will not protect you for long from some of the mobs out there! Get yourself some Pokémon Armor so you can defeat em' all!

menu.name: Catching
menu.description: You have your starter Pokémon... but you need more friends to add to your team! These recipes will give you the best tools to catch the best.

menu.name: Training
menu.description: There is only one way to become the best, and that is training with your team! Learn all the epic recipes to make your Pokémon stronger and become the Champion!

menu.name: Caring
menu.description: The Nurses at spawn can be such a hassle to travel to, let's get you started on your own at-home care with these Recipes!

menu.name: Building & Storage
menu.description: Light up your base, and pull every barrel you own into one screen with a Crafting Terminal.

recipes.title: Re-dye concrete
recipes.note: 8 concrete of any other colour around one dye gives 8 of the dye's colour. One recipe per colour: white, orange, magenta, light blue, yellow, lime, pink, gray, light gray, cyan, purple, blue, brown, green, red, black.

recipes.title: Slabs back to a block
recipes.note: Two of the same slab side by side, anywhere in the grid. Works for every slab that has a full block.

recipes.title: Stairs back to blocks
recipes.note: Four of the same stairs in a 2x2, anywhere in the grid.
Two logs stacked vertically, anywhere in the grid.

CRAFTING_TERMINAL.label: Beat Gym 5
CRAFTING_TERMINAL.how: Granted when you beat the fifth PokéSurvival gym (Delphine, Water). See the Gyms page.

RECIPE_NETHERITE.label: Nether access (beat Gym 3)
RECIPE_NETHERITE.how: No separate unlock — you need Netherite Ingots, and the Nether only opens once you beat the third gym (Dex, Electric/Normal).

RECIPE_CATCH_50.label: Catch 50 Pokémon
RECIPE_CATCH_50.reward: Great, Heavy, Love, Friend, Moon Balls

RECIPE_CATCH_100.label: Catch 100 Pokémon
RECIPE_CATCH_100.reward: Net, Repeat, Dive, Nest, Luxury Balls

RECIPE_WILD_5.label: Defeat 5 wild Pokémon
RECIPE_WILD_5.reward: Potion, Antidote, Burn Heal, Awakening, Paralyze Heal, Ice Heal

RECIPE_WILD_250.label: Defeat 250 wild Pokémon
RECIPE_WILD_250.reward: Max Potion, Full Restore, Max Revive, Max Ether, Max Elixir

T1_TM.label: Defeat 25 trainer NPCs
T1_TM.reward: Tier 1 TMs at the TM trader

T2_TM.label: Defeat 100 trainer NPCs
T2_TM.reward: Tier 2 TMs at the TM trader

T3_TM.label: Defeat 500 trainer NPCs
T3_TM.reward: Tier 3 TMs at the TM trader
